newsitem.title: USA: Sony will sell Web TV box in September.
newsitem.headline: Sony will sell Web TV box in September.

text.p: Sony Electronics Inc. said Monday it will begin selling equipment next month that will enable netsurfing via a television set.
The company said it decided to debut the Sony Web TV Internet Terminal ahead of schedule and has increased its production of the small box because of strong demand from electronic retailers.
"The price is quite economical," said Sony spokesman Rick Clancy, noting the device's $349 price tag, in comparison with the $1,000 price of most modem-equipped computers.
The box will come with a remote control device, or it can be used with a keyboard, Clancy said.
The terminal will plug into a phone line and a television. It will provide Internet access through Web TV Networks, Inc., of Palo Alto, Calif.
The California company originally developed the technology for the box and has licensed both Sony and Philips Consumer Electronics Co. to produce it.
